note: Expected profile detection (plan §5 WP3.1, AD-11), read by src/lib/core/profiles/detect.test.ts.
`fixtures` has one entry for every file under tests/fixtures/nc; the test fails when a fixture is added without one.
A value is a profile id, or 'fallback' when the content is inconclusive and the current profile stays,
or 'refused' when decodeFile does not open the file at all, so detection never runs.
`improvements` lists the cases whose answer moved from the M0 characterization (utils/detectLanguage.ts).
Every fixture above answers exactly as it did at M0: only the hand-written cases below moved.

improvements.case: a Klartext program saved with a Fanuc extension: the content outvotes the extension weight
improvements.text:
0 BEGIN PGM PROG MM
1 TOOL CALL 5 Z S2000
2 L Z+100 R0 FMAX
3 END PGM PROG MM

improvements.case: a Fanuc program saved as .h: the same rule the other way round
a program number of more than five digits is still a program number (the profile allows eight)
